data.one_liner: Kotlin-style extension methods for Dart types including String, bool, Iterable, and List.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility extension methods and helper classes similar to Kotlin's standard library for Dart primitive and collection types. Includes extensions for String, bool, Iterable, and List, plus global utilities like Pair, let, also, and run.
use_when: You want Kotlin-style scoping functions (let, also, run) in Dart.
You need convenient extension methods on Strings, booleans, and iterables.
avoid_when: You prefer to write your own custom extensions to keep dependencies minimal.
You only need standard Dart collection utilities.
strengths: Brings familiar Kotlin utility functions and methods to Dart.
weaknesses: Small feature set limited to basic types.
No documentation on some features beyond a brief list.
